name: Ziegelon

source_image.note: Original user-supplied artwork. Treat as the visual source of truth.

logo_structure.symbol: stylized orange brick wall combined with a dark calculator

implementation_rules: Do not redraw or alter the supplied logo unless explicitly requested.
Do not add shadows, outlines, gradients, bevels, extra bricks, or extra calculator keys.
Keep the brick/calculator proportions and relative placement unchanged.
Use the original PNG when exact visual fidelity is required.
For a true vector master, have the supplied artwork manually redrawn in Figma/Illustrator; do not auto-trace the raster and assume it is production-perfect.
Do not use JPG for logo assets.
Keep the logo visually clear at small sizes; use the symbol-only version for app launcher icons.
